name: Choose a New Password
description: Displays the password replacement surface after recovery-code verification has established reset authority internally.

conformance.notes: The CommonLinks member name is recorded by legacy route metadata, but its repository, source path, and current value have not yet been deterministically located. The canonical route no longer carries reset authority in a URL parameter.

Angular registers the canonical password/reset/complete path with no reset-token parameter and binds it to ResetPasswordComponent. The legacy password/reset/:code route remains a compatibility alias only.

Expo Router exposes the canonical completion path and binds it to PasswordRecoveryResetScreen with reset authority held in AuthFlowContext. The legacy /auth/reset-password route remains a compatibility alias.

notes: Reset authority is application state established by successful six-digit code verification and is never part of the canonical route.
Legacy token-bearing routes may remain temporarily as compatibility aliases but are not canonical projections.
